abstract: One hundred seventeen solid ovarian tumours, diagnosed histologically during the period between 1971 and 1990, were studied. The overall incidence of solid ovarian tumours was 23.4% of all the ovarian tumours (500 cases) studied. Of 117 solid ovarian tumours 19 (16.2%) were benign and the rest 98 (83.8%) were malignant. Epithelial tumours were the commonest (28.2%) followed by germ cell tumours (22.2%), sex cord stromal tumours (21.4%), metastatic tumours (19.7%) and non-specific tumours (8.5%). The average age (26.8 years) was comparatively low for germ cell tumours otherwise in other groups it ranged between 42 and 45 years. Below 15 years immature teratoma was diagnosed in 4 cases and granulosa cell tumour in 2 cases. Bilateral tumours were seen in 22 cases (23.2%) out of 95 cases observed. Pain and fullness in the pelvic region were observed in 94.9% cases. Varied morphological picture was seen in 6 cases of endometrioid carcinoma. Dysgerminoma constituted 6.8% of solid ovarian tumours. Gliomatosis peritonei was noticed in one case of immature teratoma. Granulosa cell tumour accounted for 11.1% of solid ovarian tumours. Of 23 cases of metastatic tumours, Krukenberg tumour was noticed in 88.9% cases. Diagnostic problems as well as prognostic factors of solid ovarian tumours have been discussed.
abstract_ja: 1971年から1990年の間に組織学的に診断された充実性卵巣腫瘍117例を検討した。充実性卵巣腫瘍の全体的な頻度は、検討した全卵巣腫瘍（500例）の23.4%であった。117例の充実性卵巣腫瘍のうち19例（16.2%）が良性、残りの98例（83.8%）が悪性であった。上皮性腫瘍が最も多く（28.2%）、次いで胚細胞腫瘍（22.2%）、性索間質性腫瘍（21.4%）、転移性腫瘍（19.7%）、非特異的腫瘍（8.5%）であった。胚細胞腫瘍の平均年齢（26.8歳）は他の群（42〜45歳）より低かった。15歳未満では未熟奇形腫が4例、顆粒膜細胞腫瘍が2例診断された。検討した95例のうち22例（23.2%）で両側性腫瘍が認められた。骨盤部の疼痛および充満感が94.9%の症例でみられた。子宮内膜様癌6例では多彩な形態像が観察された。ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）は充実性卵巣腫瘍の6.8%を占めた。未熟奇形腫1例で腹膜神経膠腫症が認められた。顆粒膜細胞腫瘍は充実性卵巣腫瘍の11.1%を占めた。転移性腫瘍23例のうち88.9%がクルッケンベルグ腫瘍であった。充実性卵巣腫瘍の診断上の問題点および予後因子について考察した。
